explainTr: Önceden düşündüğün planları 'be going to + fiil' ile anlatırsın: I am going to visit Linda. Be fiili özneye göre değişir: am / is / are.
Olumsuz için be fiilinin yanına 'not' koyarsın: She isn't going to cook. Soruda be fiili başa gelir: Are you going to come?
'Going to' bir de elindeki işarete bakarak tahmin yapmak için kullanılır: Look at the clouds! It is going to rain.
grammar.compareTr: Türkçede plan için 'yapacağım' (-ecek) eki yeter. İngilizcede üç parça lazım: be + going to + yalın fiil. 'I am going to cook' dersin; 'I going to cook' eksik kalır.
table: am not / isn't / aren't going to
Am / Is / Are + özne + going to?

reading.title: Hafsa's weekend plans
reading.text:
This Saturday is going to be a busy day for Hafsa. In the morning, she is going to visit Linda. Linda is going to show her a small museum downtown. After that, they are going to have a picnic by the lake, because the weather is going to be sunny.

Emre is not going to come with them. He is going to study for a test at home. In the evening, Hafsa and Emre are going to go to the movie theater. Emre is going to buy the tickets online, and Hafsa is going to bring some snacks.

On Sunday, Hafsa is not going to do much. She is going to relax at home. She is not going to cook, and she is not going to clean. Her plan for Sunday is simple: tea, a book and a long rest.

questions.whyTr: Metin: 'Emre is going to buy the tickets online'.

questions.q: What is Hafsa going to do on Sunday?

script.speaker: Linda
script.text: Hi Hafsa. What are you going to do this weekend?

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: On Saturday I'm going to visit the museum downtown. Do you want to come?

script.speaker: Linda
script.text: I'd love to! Are you going to take the bus?

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: No, we aren't. Emre is going to drive us.

script.speaker: Linda
script.text: Great. What time are you going to leave?

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: We're going to leave at ten.

script.speaker: Linda
script.text: Okay. Am I going to need money for the tickets?

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Yes, about ten dollars. But lunch is free. I'm going to make sandwiches.

script.speaker: Linda
script.text: Wonderful. Is the weather going to be nice?

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: The news says it is going to rain in the afternoon, so bring an umbrella.

script.speaker: Linda
script.text: I will. Thank you for inviting me!

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: You're welcome. See you on Saturday!
